rule.data: validation seeds 2000-2002, dedicated ports, D1-D3, A1-A7 + gap sweep + benign-only
rule.feasible: mean benign harm on A1-A7 <= v2.1's + 0.5 points and benign-only harm <= v2.1's + 0.1 points
rule.objective: minimise mean benign harm over the gap sweep
rule.tie_break: within 0.05 points: lower mean attacker occupancy over the gap sweep, then fewer overflow seconds
rule.fallback: if none is feasible: minimise total constraint violation (points), then the objective
rule.applies_to: the selected knobs are used for v2.1+pfs, pfs and dms-blocklist+pfs

hypotheses.H1: dedicated: over gaps <= 1 s, v2.1+pfs harms fewer benign flows than v2.1 (cluster Wilcoxon, Holm)
hypotheses.H2: dedicated: on A1-A7, v2.1+pfs is non-inferior to v2.1 (mean harm difference <= 0.5 points)
hypotheses.H3: dedicated: on A1-A7, v2.1+pfs harms fewer than pfs alone (detector contribution)
hypotheses.H4: dedicated: over all attacks, v2.1+pfs harms fewer than dms-blocklist+pfs
hypotheses.H5: dedicated: at every gap, v2.1+pfs mean harm <= 3 %
hypotheses.H6: distributed (expected negative): over gaps <= 1 s, v2.1+pfs does not reduce harm vs v2.1

gap_variant: step 100, t1 in [0.9g, g], benign sizes, spoofed sources, burst rate max(1500, 1.25*1700/(0.9g)) pps per attacker
statistics: cluster bootstrap and cluster Wilcoxon over (domain, seed), Holm within family
